title: Towards Trustworthy GUI Agents: A Survey
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze aspects of religion or faith. The benchmarks discussed measure technical aspects of GUI agent trustworthiness, such as adversarial robustness, handling of harmful tasks, policy compliance, and cultural awareness in a general social context.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it focuses on the technical challenges and trustworthiness of Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents.
